The '''2,367th annual Priole Danna Festival''' was held in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] in [[Gryle City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]. The 2,367th incarnation of the [[Priole Danna Festival]], it was celebrated by beings drawn from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
